title: Protect the host
signature: Never run disk formatting, boot configuration, system-wide ACL replacement, recursive deletion of user roots, or shutdown operations as project maintenance.
forbidden: Do not execute host-destructive commands or broaden permissions to bypass a project error.

title: Protect secret stores
signature: Never scan protected secret stores or record passwords, tokens, cookies, private keys, verification codes, or complete sensitive responses.
forbidden: Do not traverse secret stores, request their ACLs, or persist secret values.

tags: git reset clean rebase merge checkout staging push
title: Protect project history and worktrees
signature: Dirty worktrees are authoritative user state; destructive Git history and broad staging operations can lose unrelated work.
forbidden: Do not run reset --hard, clean, rebase, merge, checkout --, broad staging, or push without explicit authorization.

tags: esp32 firmware platformio pio build cache release
title: Protect firmware outputs
signature: Firmware build output, cache, binaries, and release artifacts must survive every build or upload failure.
forbidden: Never delete firmware build output or cache; stop and ask the user when a firmware build problem needs cleanup.

tags: retry repeat loop unchanged command failure
title: Prevent blind retry loops
signature: After a failure, search the Error Guard and change an evidenced condition before retrying; an unchanged failed command is not a correction.
forbidden: Do not repeat an unchanged failed operation or make a third attempt after the same corrected failure.

tags: recursive scan delete glob root timeout context
title: Bound recursive operations
signature: Broad recursive scans and deletes over user roots, temp roots, Codex state, build output, or unknown ownership paths cause timeouts, access errors, or data loss.
forbidden: Do not recursively scan or delete broad roots; use exact bounded paths and prove ownership before cleanup.

tags: long build test timeout monitor process
title: Long operations need one monitored run
signature: Start a long build or integration test once, provide bounded monitoring, and stop on lock wait, no progress, repeated exception, or timeout.
forbidden: Do not launch duplicate builds, background retries, or unbounded tests.

tags: frontend vite node temporary test delete lock
title: Handle frontend test locks correctly
signature: Undeletable frontend temporary test files commonly indicate an active frontend process rather than an ACL defect.
forbidden: Check and stop the owned frontend process before retrying deletion; do not change ACLs first.
